baseline: Current SN1_H1 code after DM-20260929-01 split-date ATR correction: annual expanding separate High/Low Ridge, fixed event-percentile EWMA and SIDE_SOURCE_SEPARATION transform; independently rebuilt current-code path must reproduce bit for bit. DM-20260927-04 saved H1 was generated with the pre-correction feature hash and is historical context only.
train_window: Train only: 2008-11-04 through 2016-03-31; evaluation folds 2011 through 2016

confirmation_policy: All Train periods are previously inspected development data. Baseline is a current-code reproduction control. The archived DM-20260927-04 H1 score is not comparable because its directional feature code predates the split-date ATR correction; verify this with the recorded source hashes. Candidate B is run only if Candidate A passes the pre-registered information gate. No holdout, Valid evaluation, or post-result tuning.

trials.comparison: SN1_H1 baseline vs same side-specific Ridge with fixed Event-Box structural features added
Candidate A vs Candidate A plus UPSTATE × max(0, -box_position); run only if A improves pooled RankIC, gross performance, and Q5-Q1

feature_definitions: Existing five directional SN1 inputs plus causal Event-Box features computed from raw OHLC in a split-safe share unit: UP/DOWN structure, persistent last breakout strength by direction, current/last confirmed box width in prior ATR units, box age, structure age, breakout age, failure pulse, and normalized box position. Candidate B adds pullback_up = upstate * max(0, -x). Prior-only ATR20; seed box from prior 20 sessions; width 0.5-3.0 prior ATR; k_bo=1, k_fail=0.5, reversal=1 ATR, formation timeout=40; confirmed_at is signal-date only. Invalid OHLC and listing gaps over 20 sessions reset state.
model: Separate High and Low expanding Ridge on their existing 250-session breakout-event rows; High target is positive date-wise centered H1 residual rank, Low target is its negative. Standardization/imputation and score transformations match SN1_H1.
selection_rule: Candidate A is allowed to proceed to B only with positive pooled delta RankIC, positive pooled delta gross return, and positive mean Q5-Q1 change vs baseline. A candidate is supported only if mean RankIC, Q5-Q1, and annual gross improve; gross uplift is positive in at least 4/6 yearly folds; Net Sharpe is no lower; the result is not cost-only or concentrated in one year; and for B the UPSTATE=1,x<0 bucket has positive incremental target-rank information vs UPSTATE=0,x<0. Otherwise reject or classify mixed, with no tuning.
